arxiv-2103-09938.title: Geometrical constructions of equilibrium states
arxiv-2103-09938.creator: Pablo D. Carrasco, Federico Rodriguez-Hertz
arxiv-2103-09938.description: Abstract . In this note we report some advances in the study of thermodynamic formalism for a class of partially hyperbolic system – center isometries, that includes regular elements in Anosov actions. The techniques are of geometric flavor (in particular, not relying in symbolic dynamics) and even provide new information in the classical case.

arxiv-2110-06184.title: GLADE+: An Extended Galaxy Catalogue for Multimessenger Searches with Advanced Gravitational-wave Detectors 2021 GLADE+: An Extended Galaxy Catalogue for Multimessenger Searches with Advanced Gravitational-wave Detectors – References
arxiv-2110-06184.creator: G. Dálya, R. Díaz, F. R. Bouchet, Z. Frei, J. Jasche, G. Lavaux, R. Macas, S. Mukherjee, M. Pálfi, R. S. de Souza, B. D. Wandelt, M. Bilicki, P. Raffai
arxiv-2110-06184.description: Abstract We present GLADE+, an extended version of the GLADE galaxy catalogue introduced in our previous paper for multimessenger searches with advanced gravitational-wave detectors. GLADE+ combines data from six separate but not independent astronomical catalogues: the GWGC, 2MPZ, 2MASS XSC, HyperLEDA, and WISExSCOSPZ galaxy catalogues, and the SDSS-DR16Q quasar catalogue.

arxiv-2201-06488.title: On Hochschild homology of uniform Roe algebras with coefficients in uniform Roe bimodules
arxiv-2201-06488.creator: V. Manuilov
arxiv-2201-06488.description: Abstract . It was shown recently by M. Lorentz and R. Willett that all bounded derivations of the uniform Roe algebras of metric spaces of bounded geometry are inner. Here we calculate the space of outer derivations of the uniform Roe algebras with coefficients in uniform Roe bimodules related to various metrics on the two copies of the given space.

arxiv-2204-13506.title: A Hamiltonian Dysthe equation for deep-water gravity waves with constant vorticity
arxiv-2204-13506.creator: Philippe Guyenne, Adilbek Kairzhan, Catherine Sulem
arxiv-2204-13506.description: Abstract . This paper is a study of the water wave problem in a two-dimensional domain of infinite depth in the presence of nonzero constant vorticity. A goal is to describe the effects of uniform shear flow on the modulation of weakly nonlinear quasi-monochromatic surface gravity waves.

arxiv-2208-09039.title: The rate of accumulation of negative eigenvalues to zero and the absolutely continuous spectrum
arxiv-2208-09039.creator: Oleg Safronov
arxiv-2208-09039.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Oleg Safronov. For a bounded real-valued function V V on ℝ d {\mathbb{R}}^{d} , we consider two Schrödinger operators H + = − Δ + V H_{+}=-\Delta+V and H − = − Δ − V H_{-}=-\Delta-V .

arxiv-2307-06278.title: Disorder operators and magnetic vortices in SU(N) lattice gauge theory
arxiv-2307-06278.creator: Manu Mathur, Atul Rathor 1
arxiv-2307-06278.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Manu Mathur, Atul Rathor 1. We construct the most general disorder operator for SU(N) lattice gauge theory in ( 2 + 1 ) (2+1) dimension by using exact duality transformations. These disorder operators, defined on the plaquettes and characterized by ( N − 1 \text{N}-1 ) angles, are the creation & annihilation or the shift operators for the SU(N) magnetic vortices carrying ( N − 1 ) (\text{N}-1) types of magnetic fluxes.

arxiv-2312-04238.title: Long-lived Particles Anomaly Detection with Parametrized Quantum Circuits
arxiv-2312-04238.creator: Simone Bordoni, Denis Stanev, Tommaso Santantonio, Stefano Giagu
arxiv-2312-04238.description: Abstract We investigate the possibility to apply quantum machine learning techniques for data analysis, with particular regard to an interesting use-case in high-energy physics. We propose an anomaly detection algorithm based on a parametrized quantum circuit. This algorithm has been trained on a classical computer and tested with simulations as well as on real quantum hardware.

arxiv-2403-12809.title: Comparing Explanation Faithfulness between Multilingual and Monolingual Fine-tuned Language Models
arxiv-2403-12809.creator: Zhixue Zhao, Nikolaos Aletras
arxiv-2403-12809.description: Abstract In many real natural language processing application scenarios, practitioners not only aim to maximize predictive performance but also seek faithful explanations for the model predictions. Rationales and importance distribution given by feature attribution methods (FAs) provide insights into how different parts of the input contribute to a prediction.

arxiv-2507-07323.title: Optimizing Model Splitting and Device Task Assignment for Deceptive Signal Assisted Private Multi-hop Split Learning
arxiv-2507-07323.creator: Dongyu Wei, Xiaoren Xu, Yuchen Liu, , H. Vincent Poor, , and Mingzhe Chen
arxiv-2507-07323.description: Abstract In this paper, deceptive signal-assisted private split learning is investigated. In our model, several edge devices jointly perform collaborative training, and some eavesdroppers aim to collect the model and data information from devices. To prevent the eavesdroppers from collecting model and data information, a subset of devices can transmit deceptive signals.

pmc-10675384.title: DICER-LIKE2 Plays a Crucial Role in Rice Stripe Virus Coat Protein-Mediated Virus Resistance in Arabidopsis
pmc-10675384.creator: Li Chen, Yanan Liu, Shuo Li, Yinghua Ji, Feng Sun, Baohong Zou
pmc-10675384.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). Virus coat protein (CP)-mediated resistance is considered an effective antiviral defense strategy that has been used to develop robust resistance to viral infection. Rice stripe virus (RSV) causes significant losses in rice production in eastern Asia. We previously showed that the overexpression of RSV CP in Arabidopsis plants results in immunity to RSV infection, using the RSV-Arabidopsis pathosystem, and this CP-mediated viral resistance depends on the function of DCLs and is mostly involved in RNA silencing.

pmc-10730667.title: The MultiFurcating Neighbor-Joining Algorithm for Reconstructing Polytomic Phylogenetic Trees
pmc-10730667.creator: Alberto Fernández, Natàlia Segura-Alabart, Francesc Serratosa
pmc-10730667.description: Results from phylogenetic analyses that study the evolution of species according to their biological characteristics are frequently structured as phylogenetic trees. One of the most widely used methods for reconstructing them is the distance-based method known as the neighbor-joining (NJ) algorithm.

pmc-11485090.title: Functional foods in Mediterranean diet: exploring the functional features of vegetable case-studies obtained also by biotechnological approaches
pmc-11485090.creator: Anna Rita Bavaro, Annamaria Tarantini, Angelica Bruno, Antonio F Logrieco, Antonia Gallo, Giovanni Mita, Francesca Valerio, Gianluca Bleve, Angela Cardinali
pmc-11485090.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). The Mediterranean Diet (MedDiet) is a widely recognized dietary pattern, with its effects largely attributed to “functional foods” which are able to positively influence one or more target functions, improving health and maintaining a state of well-being.In this review, three “case-study” typical of the MedDiet, such as artichokes, capers and table olives are considered as traditional functional vegetables rich in bioactive compounds, mainly polyphenols.

pmc-13038553.title: Bibliometric analysis of stereotactic ablative radiotherapy for oligometastases
pmc-13038553.creator: Yupeng Di, Zhuo Song, Yingjie Wang, Lingling Meng, Jing Li
pmc-13038553.description: BackgroundOligometastases, an intermediate stage of metastatic cancer, are increasingly managed with Stereotactic Ablative Radiotherapy (SABR), a highly precise local therapy representing a pivotal paradigm shift for improving patient outcomes. This study aimed to comprehensively map the research landscape of SABR for oligometastases.

pmc-13108078.title: Automated Annuloplasty with VirtuoSEW® in microInvasive Mitral Valve Repair (μMVr)
pmc-13108078.creator: Nermir Granov, Farhad Bakhtiary, Armin Šljivo, Jude S. Sauer
pmc-13108078.description: Background/Objectives: Totally endoscopic mitral valve repair reduces surgical trauma and accelerates recovery but can be technically challenging, particularly for precise annuloplasty suturing. Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. (a) Audits For purposes of section 10101 of title 36 the Foundation shall be treated as a corporation in part B of subtitle II of title 36. (b) Annual reports The Foundation shall transmit each year to Congress a report.
